# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:**
When the Divine established and formed the discrete degrees of spiritual order, He arranged each degree so that it depended upon the degree above it, and also upon a still more interior degree. The outermost degree consists of the five complete genera of falsity from evil, in both their intellectual and volitional forms.

**¶3:**
This is why one degree of spiritual order was made to depend upon the degree above it. The five genera of falsity from evil were made subject to the five genera of radiant divine truth proceeding from the Divine Human — because all opposition arising from evil is held restrained and subjugated within these truths. Each genus of falsity is bound by its corresponding genus of wisdom.

**¶4:**
Also, within the interior degree dwell the five essential powers of the [GAP-1: REVIEW — the living divine] Proceeding; because the entire structure of spiritual order is sustained by them, it being [GAP-2: — the spiritual sense requires: that each degree perceives and receives influx from the degree above — he] received from him also, the oth[GAP-3: er degrees of order — each successive degree receiving influx] after them.

**¶5:**
And this is the One who descended into [GAP-4: — spiritual sense requires: the governing function over — the interior rational] boundaries above [GAP-5: — all subordinate degrees], which exists as one sovereign degree, namely the great [GAP-6: REVIEW — the Divine Good governing in its celestial glory] who ex[GAP-7: ists in sovereign dominion] within the [GAP-8: — inmost life] of the whole of creation.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of darkness, males and females.
This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.
Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [that they also he]ard (?) him too, the oth[ers that were set] after them.
And this is the one who came to [rule over the fi]rmaments above [them all] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists in his honour] within the [very midst] of the universe.

fills.explanation: The "Living Spirit" is the standard Manichaean title for the cosmic demiurge whose five sons sustain the physical cosmos; the spiritual reading confirms "the living divine Proceeding," and this is the universal designation in the Kephalaia.

The spiritual reading requires "that each degree perceives and receives influx from the degree above"; in natural register, the five sons also "heard" (received from) the one above them, expressing the chain of influx through successive zones.

The spiritual reading specifies "each successive degree receiving influx" in ordered arrangement; in Kephalaia register, the other zones "that were set after them" describes the successive degrees established in their ordered positions below the five sons.

The King of Honour's specific cosmological function is governing the firmaments; the spiritual reading confirms "the governing function over the interior rational boundaries," and "rule over" is the standard Kephalaia expression for this office.

The spiritual reading specifies "all subordinate degrees" at this position; in the natural register, the firmaments are above all the lower zones, with "them all" referring to the subordinate powers and zones described in the preceding paragraphs.

The King of Honour is the specific son of the Living Spirit who governs the firmaments in Manichaean cosmology; the spiritual reading's "Divine Good governing in celestial glory" maps perfectly to this title, as "honour" corresponds to celestial governance and glory.

By correspondential logic, natural "honour" maps to spiritual "sovereign dominion"; since this is the King of Honour, his mode of existence is fittingly described as being "in his honour," which the spiritual reading translates as "in sovereign dominion."

The spiritual reading says "inmost life"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, "the very midst of the universe" is the standard cosmological expression for the innermost center where governing power resides, with "very" capturing the "inmost" quality.
